objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document object; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, additional info, and attachment.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to a document and adapted to requirements.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document and adapted to requirements.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is retained or updated through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in status networks and workflows.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author and personal authorization.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers and personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers and personal authorization.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date and define when a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose change affects distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used to describe locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to describe specific procedures within a framework or process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed work steps in sub-processes.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system when creating new documents or adding additional information or attachments.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: Document generated based on standard MS Office formats.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object with which documents can be linked, including examples such as IT applications.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or system user who may create, edit, review, release, read, translate, acknowledge, or receive notifications about documents.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION to provide users with appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: Role shown in brackets for available system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, distribution, and dashboard relevance to users.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to assign read and change rights to users or persons.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User role that can view approved objects and dependent objects such as attachments.

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role whose assigned users are offered in author or co-author selection lists and receive read and write permissions when assigned.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User assigned additional personal change rights and allowed to start the release process.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for the document and its content and deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with it, subject to versioning, and archived with release of the next main document version.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object added to a document to describe it in more detail and released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment mentioned as additional information or equippments that can be added to each document and reactivated with the document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for an existing document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow used for document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task completed by workflow participants, including acknowledgement tasks and tasks signed electronically.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow status, tasks, change proposals, distribution, validity extension, override, and acknowledgements.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and automatically start workflow processing.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents and start a workflow.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment list of User Groups and persons used for read authorization, e-mail distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboards.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by persons or users of assigned User Groups that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view filled based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report used to evaluate documents, instructions, workflows, and acknowledgements with selection parameters.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released content or documents checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: cockpit
objs.description: Document area where Change proposals are created and managed and Distribution lists are maintained.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a defined document template when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or generated.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document using the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document_pdf
evts.description: Display the current PDF version of a document on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_document_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader_authorization
evts.description: Assign authorizations for readers via User Group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign a user as author for a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign a reviewer for a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign a releaser for a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark released attachments for archiving and archive them with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step workflow-supported approval process after creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release and cancel the workflow for subsequent participants after first rejection.

evts.name: notify_workflow_participant
evts.description: Inform involved users of workflow status and workflow tasks by e-mail notification.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: print_signature
evts.description: Print participant signatures as document content.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, causing creation of a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: notify_document_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a Change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: print_change_proposal
evts.description: Print Change proposals in the document for information purposes.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: Send an e-mail notification to the Creator of the proposal after editing is documented.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Create and manage Change proposals in the Cockpit in the Change proposals folder.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the document valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised document version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after extended validity is declared, a new revised version is released, or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Automatically start and process the workflow for the request for AKS.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and their attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Give the last valid and approved version of the document the status Out of force and revoke rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow after creating a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the reactivation request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new document version and restoring retained metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons in the Distribution list for a document.

evts.name: assign_read_authorization
evts.description: Automatically give read authorization to User Groups and persons assigned to the Distribution.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail upon release from persons and users of User Groups maintained for acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of the relevant document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Notify the author team about unconfirmed acknowledgements and when all maintained persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: list_document
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: select_document
evts.description: Select a document from the dashboard list to display detailed information.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Display details such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions.

evts.name: evaluate_instruction
evts.description: Evaluate instructions stored in the system with additional information depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: evaluate_editing_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents saved in the system in editing status with additional information depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: evaluate_document_revision_cycle
evts.description: Evaluate documents stored in the system with revision cycle and traffic light status.

evts.name: evaluate_current_document_status
evts.description: Evaluate documents stored in the system by current workflow status and traffic light status.

evts.name: list_acknowledgement
evts.description: List acknowledgements depending on status.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: assign_translation_participant
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing the translation in the document properties dialog.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients the corresponding document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the client to make a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new document objects.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover for a document.
New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with Master data.
Documents can be linked with other documents, and local documents can reference original documents.
Work instructions can be supplemented with additional forms.
Work instructions can be supplemented with additional checklists.
Users are assigned to User Groups by technical administration and through reader and distribution groups.
User Groups are assigned to documents for reader authorization, author roles, distribution, and archive access.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents to assign read and change rights.
Persons are assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, and distribution recipient.
Readers can view approved documents and dependent objects.
An author is assigned to a document and signs the creation workflow step.
Co-authors can be assigned personal change rights on a document.
Reviewers are maintained on a document and check it during review.
Releasers are maintained on a document and release it.
Translator can translate released document content into another language.
Attachments are controlled documents associated with a main document and released or archived with it.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Equippments can be added to each document and reactivated with archived documents.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution list is maintained per document with User Groups and persons.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Persons can be assigned directly to the Distribution list.
Acknowledgement is confirmed for the current version of a document.
Documents are assigned in dashboards for users included in distribution groups.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
A report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
A document can have translated language versions visible in the corresponding login language after release.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Change proposals and distribution list are managed in the cockpit for a document.
Workflow-supported processing consists of workflow tasks for participants.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
The system informs involved users of workflow status and tasks by e-mail notifications.
